title: provenance-substrate: the model proposes, deterministic code disposes, a human signs
description: A dependency-free Python library and language-neutral conformance suite for making AI-assisted work checkable. A model's output is a claim; a deterministic engine (the Lean kernel, a re-executed computation, an arithmetic reconciler) must confirm it; a human signs the exact bytes; every step is hash-chained. Wedges: ledgers, Lean proofs, manuscript claims, paper reproductions, a quantitative-hallucination benchmark, peer-review provenance. Byte-compatible with the @kernel.chat/kbot-finance TypeScript reference (finance v1 conformance suite vendored, 143 vectors).
